reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Introduce Room SQLite / SwiftData database to store routes and stops
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Bundled canonical JSON assets load instantly in memory with zero SQL migrations, ORM overhead, or database sync bugs.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Simulate moving bus pins and countdowns ('Arriving in 3m')
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Deceptive and violates project operating rules. Scheduled timetables are strictly labeled as timetables.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Estimate bus fares based on distance calculations (e.g. ₹10 base + ₹2/km)
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Fabrication of commercial data is prohibited. Fares remain strictly null/unavailable until official CRUT fare tables are ingested.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Add 6th bottom navigation item / tab for Transit
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Violates frozen 5-root architecture. Transit is reached via Discover root portal banner or Map corridor selection.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Add SQLite FTS5 or external search library for transit query matching
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Pure Kotlin/Swift 6-tier deterministic search engine is fast (<2ms over 154 routes) and zero-dependency.

reductions_and_simplifications.proposal: Geocode the 1,257 locality-only stops with centroid approximation
reductions_and_simplifications.rationale: Hallucinating physical bus pole coordinates sends travelers to the middle of nowhere. Locality disclosure is honest and accurate.
